# Unity Documentation

> Docs and guides to work with the Unity ecosystem. Each product has a dedicated llms.txt file with specific product documentation guides.

## Docs

- [Unity Ads Android Monetization](https://docs.unity.com/ads-android/llms.txt): Integrate Unity Ads into your Android app by referring to the SDK integration guide and the privacy guides.
- [Unity Ads iOS Monetization](https://docs.unity.com/ads-ios/llms.txt): Integrate Unity Ads into your iOS app by referring to the SDK integration guide and the privacy guides.
- [Unity Ads Monetization](https://docs.unity.com/ads-unity/llms.txt): Integrate Unity Ads into your Unity project by referring to the SDK integration guide and the privacy guides.
- [Unity AI](https://docs.unity.com/ai/llms.txt): Make creation with Unity faster and easier. Unity AI provides contextual assistance, automates tedious tasks, generates assets, and lowers the barrier to entry - all from within the Unity Editor.
- [Analytics](https://docs.unity.com/analytics/llms.txt): Analyze player engagement, optimize game performance, and make data-driven decisions to enhance your game's success.
- [Archive](https://docs.unity.com/archive/llms.txt): Archive
- [Unity Asset Store](https://docs.unity.com/asset-store/llms.txt): The Unity Asset Store contains a library of free and commercial assets that Unity Technologies and members of the community create.
- [Asset Transformer SDK](https://docs.unity.com/asset-transformer-sdk/llms.txt): Import, prepare and optimize 3D assets with Unity Asset Transformer.
- [Authentication](https://docs.unity.com/authentication/llms.txt): Implement secure player authentication with anonymous, platform-specific, and custom sign-in solutions for your game.
- [Authentication for Unreal](https://docs.unity.com/authentication-unreal/llms.txt): Understand how to implement anonymous and platform-specific authentication in Unreal Engine.
- [Build Automation](https://docs.unity.com/build-automation/llms.txt): Use Unity Build Automation and its continuous integration features for multiplatform builds.
- [Cloud Content Delivery](https://docs.unity.com/ccd/llms.txt): Use Unity's managed cloud service for live game updates to host and deliver game content worldwide without app reinstalls.
- [Multiplay Clanforge](https://docs.unity.com/clanforge/llms.txt): Documentation for Welcome to Clanforge
- [Unity Cloud](https://docs.unity.com/cloud/llms.txt): Adapt to the evolving challenges of game development with Unity Cloud, a platform of connected products and services. Unity Cloud supports workflows for all team members across all development stages, with tools to collaborate, manage assets, and administer teams.
- [Cloud Code](https://docs.unity.com/cloud-code/llms.txt): Write and run server-side code on a fully managed infrastructure that scales automatically to meet your traffic demands.
- [Cloud Diagnostics](https://docs.unity.com/cloud-diagnostics/llms.txt): Collect crash reports, exceptions, debugging symbols, and player feedback to diagnose and fix issues in your game.
- [Cloud Save](https://docs.unity.com/cloud-save/llms.txt): Store player and game data in the cloud so players can access it everywhere and across devices.
- [DevOps](https://docs.unity.com/devops/llms.txt): Learn about Unity DevOps tools and workflows for efficient team collaboration.
- [Economy](https://docs.unity.com/economy/llms.txt): Learn how to create, manage, and publish an economy system for your game using Unity's Economy service.
- [Friends](https://docs.unity.com/friends/llms.txt): Explore the Friends service for managing player relationships and connections.
- [Game Overrides](https://docs.unity.com/game-overrides/llms.txt): Learn how to target specific player groups with dynamic configurations across multiple Unity services.
- [Unity Grow](https://docs.unity.com/grow/llms.txt): Turn your game into a business with Unity.
- [Unity Hub](https://docs.unity.com/hub/llms.txt): The Unity Hub is a standalone application that you can use to navigate, download, and manage your Unity projects and installations.
- [In-App Purchasing](https://docs.unity.com/iap/llms.txt): Implement a unified in-app purchasing system to sell consumable items, non-consumable entitlements, and subscriptions across multiple digital storefronts.
- [Leaderboards](https://docs.unity.com/leaderboards/llms.txt): Understand the core concepts and implementation options for Leaderboards, a gaming service that ranks and stores player scores.
- [Unity License Server](https://docs.unity.com/licensing-server/llms.txt): Learn about the Unity Licensing Server.
- [LiveOps](https://docs.unity.com/liveops/llms.txt): Keep players engaged and games thriving with an ecosystem of simple and scalable solutions.
- [Lobby](https://docs.unity.com/lobby/llms.txt)
- [Matchmaker](https://docs.unity.com/matchmaker/llms.txt): Use Matchmaker to connect players, and to create and operate multiplayer games no matter what engine you’re using.
- [Matchmaker for the Unreal Engine](https://docs.unity.com/matchmaker-unreal/llms.txt): Explore the features and resources for integrating Matchmaker into your Unreal Engine game.
- [Unity Monetization](https://docs.unity.com/monetization/llms.txt): Integrate Unity Ads into your mobile app and follow platform-specific setup guides to configure ad placements and enable in-app monetization.
- [Multiplayer](https://docs.unity.com/mps-sdk/llms.txt): Create and manage multiplayer experiences using Unity's integrated suite of services.
- [Multiplayer](https://docs.unity.com/multiplayer/llms.txt): Build multiplayer games using Unity's integrated suite of services for networking and player connections.
- [Access Client API](https://docs.unity.com/oas-access-client/llms.txt)
- [Advertising Developer API](https://docs.unity.com/oas-advertise-developer/llms.txt)
- [Asset Pipeline Client API](https://docs.unity.com/oas-assetpipeline-client/llms.txt)
- [Auth Client API](https://docs.unity.com/oas-auth-client/llms.txt)
- [Build Automation Client API](https://docs.unity.com/oas-build-automation-client/llms.txt)
- [Cloud Code Client API](https://docs.unity.com/oas-cloud-code-client/llms.txt)
- [Collaboration Public API](https://docs.unity.com/oas-collaboration-client/llms.txt)
- [DataStreaming Client API](https://docs.unity.com/oas-data-streaming-client/llms.txt)
- [IAP Client API](https://docs.unity.com/oas-iap-client/llms.txt)
- [IAP JWKS API](https://docs.unity.com/oas-iap-jwks/llms.txt)
- [Live Content Admin API](https://docs.unity.com/oas-live-content-assets-admin/llms.txt)
- [Live Content Client API](https://docs.unity.com/oas-live-content-assets-client/llms.txt)
- [Live Releases Admin API](https://docs.unity.com/oas-live-releases-admin/llms.txt)
- [Observability Logs Admin API](https://docs.unity.com/oas-observability-public/llms.txt)
- [SCIM Client API](https://docs.unity.com/oas-scim-client/llms.txt)
- [Session Observability Session Observability](https://docs.unity.com/oas-session-observability-public/llms.txt)
- [Targeting Rules Admin API](https://docs.unity.com/oas-targeting-rules-admin/llms.txt)
- [Ads Unified Platform Advertiser API](https://docs.unity.com/oas-unified-platform-advertiser-public/llms.txt)
- [Ads Unified Platform Publisher API](https://docs.unity.com/oas-unified-platform-publisher-public/llms.txt)
- [Projects and Apps Client API](https://docs.unity.com/oas-unity-client/llms.txt)
- [Webshop Admin API](https://docs.unity.com/oas-webshop-admin/llms.txt)
- [Webshop Client API](https://docs.unity.com/oas-webshop-client/llms.txt)
- [Push Notifications](https://docs.unity.com/push-notifications/llms.txt): Schedule messages to engage with players while they're not actively playing your game.
- [Relay](https://docs.unity.com/relay/llms.txt): Learn how to connect players securely using the Relay service without dedicated game servers.
- [Remote Config](https://docs.unity.com/remote-config/llms.txt): Learn about Remote Config to tune game design without deploying new versions.
- [Vivox Safe Text](https://docs.unity.com/safe-text/llms.txt): Use AI-based safety tools to customize chat filtering, detect harmful messages, and collect evidence on player behavior in game.
- [Services](https://docs.unity.com/services/llms.txt): Use Unity services to build, engage, and grow your game
- [Unity Gaming Services CLI](https://docs.unity.com/services-cli/llms.txt): The Unity Gaming Services (UGS) CLI is a unified command line interface tool for gaming services.
- [Unity Services Web APIs](https://docs.unity.com/services-web-apis/llms.txt): Use Unity Services Web APIs to build and manage your projects with your preferred language and engine.
- [Triggers](https://docs.unity.com/triggers/llms.txt): Automate server-side actions at set moments in time or as the result of server events from Unity Gaming Services.
- [Unity Studio](https://docs.unity.com/unity-studio/llms.txt): Unity Studio is a simple, no-code editor that works directly in your web browser.
- [Unity Version Control](https://docs.unity.com/unity-version-control/llms.txt): Overview of Unity Version Control features and documentation.
- [User Acquisition](https://docs.unity.com/user-acquisition/llms.txt): Use Unity User Acquisition to attract high-value users and grow your game with scalable, targeted advertising solutions.
- [Vivox Voice & Text](https://docs.unity.com/vivox/llms.txt): Enable voice and text communications in your game with Vivox and built-in safety features for cross-platform multiplayer games.
- [Vivox Core SDK](https://docs.unity.com/vivox-core/llms.txt): Add voice and text communication to your games with Vivox.
- [Vivox Unity SDK](https://docs.unity.com/vivox-unity/llms.txt): Add voice and text chat with built-in safety features to your games.
- [Vivox Unreal SDK](https://docs.unity.com/vivox-unreal/llms.txt): Learn how to add voice and text communication to your Unreal games using the Vivox Software Development Kit.
